featureMetadata.units: metres, square metres, degrees, and dimensionless fractions
featureMetadata.sideConvention: +1 is (-tangentY,tangentX), the right side in east/south raster coordinates; -1 is the opposite; ties or no evidence use 0

approximations.profiles: Equal weight per ordered skeleton vertex; tangent spans up to two neighbours each way. Snap to the highest bilinear sample within +/- half mean width along the normal, at at most half-cell spacing. Shoulders are +/- mean width from that crest, with width floored to one cell. Missing profiles or shoulders at/above the crest are skipped.
approximations.asymmetry: Median absolute difference / sum of the two half-prominence crossing distances; steep side is the shorter flank, using the median signed distance difference.
approximations.halfWidth: First half-prominence crossings of the linearly shoulder-detrended profile, sampled at at most half-cell spacing and interpolated; profiles without both crossings are skipped.
approximations.neighbourhoods: LRM and annular TPI use a square box radius ceil(mean width / cell spacing), floored to one cell and capped at the view size; TPI excludes an inner radius floor(outer / 3).
approximations.kettles: With a view context, priority-flood fills the DEM using 8-connected drainage to view edges and no-data cells. Count 8-connected components of fill depth >0.5 m with area <5000 m2; connected submerged basins remain one depression. Without context, retain TPI < -0.5 m seeds grown through TPI <0, with the legacy exterior spill-rim depth >0.5 m and edge/no-data rejection. Densities are count per km of skeleton and per km2 of segment area.
approximations.dilation: The polygon is the union of segment raster cells; centroid inclusion uses that footprint or Euclidean distance to pixel centres <= one mean width. Pixel-centre dilation has a subcell boundary approximation.
approximations.apron: Each apron is a nearest-skeleton side ribbon outside the segment, extending min(segment length, 300 m) beyond a half-mean-width edge, clipped to the view and endpoint normals. Only pixels no higher than the nearest skeleton elevation are downslope samples; slopes <3 degrees count as flat. Return the flatter side's fraction.
approximations.valley: PCA major axis of the view's lowest-quartile elevation band approximates drainage. Score is local skeleton transversality times band anisotropy times centroid elevation affinity; subtract positive prominence to approximate underlying floor. No flow routing is performed.
approximations.statistics: Finite segment pixels only; linear-interpolated p95-p05 relief and mean absolute LRM. Unavailable prominence returns NaN; other unavailable measurements return zero and cannot supply positive morphological evidence.
approximations.context: An immutable DEM view shares slope, low-band PCA, filledGrid and depressionBlobs once, and LRM/TPI rasters per distinct width-derived radius. Depression centroids include fractional x/y and a nearest-cell centroidIndex; maxDepthM is maximum fill depth. opts.cellMetres supplies square cell spacing; when absent, areaM2 is numerically pixelCount (area in cells, assuming unit spacing), and the 5000 cutoff is in cells. opts.segments prewarms radii; others are cached on first use. Recreate the context after changing the DEM.

screeningNotice.interpretation: Experimental leads based on moraine-like ridges and hummocky belts; terrain shape does not establish glacial origin.
screeningNotice.warning: Beta: experimental terrain-shape leads. Landslides and other look-alikes can appear. Compare with Glacial margin and check mapped geology or field evidence.
